priorityList: Use Bestial Wrath on cooldown, ensuring it is paired with offensive trinkets, racial abilities, and potions.
Cast Black Arrow if your Beast Cleave buff is about to expire.
Use Wailing Arrow if Bestial Wrath has less than 5 seconds remaining or the fight is nearly over.
Use Kill Command as your primary priority, especially when the Nature's Ally buff is active.
Cast Black Arrow immediately whenever the Withering Fire proc is active.
Use Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown (less than 1 GCD remaining).
Use Barbed Shot to maintain three stacks of Frenzy on your pet and to reduce the remaining cooldown of Bestial Wrath.
Cast Wailing Arrow on cooldown if not being held for the end of Bestial Wrath.
Use Cobra Shot as a filler if Wild Thrash is on cooldown, prioritizing it when the Hogstrider buff is active.
Activate offensive trinkets like Algethar Puzzle Box or Void Execution Mandate during Bestial Wrath windows.
